channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA NCRPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 2:58 PM, 14 November 2026(Saturday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bataan (Mariveles, Limay, and Orion), Cavite (Tanza, General Trias, Rosario, Noveleta, Cavite City, Kawit, Bacoor, Imus, Carmona, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Dasmarinas, and Naic), Laguna (San Pedro, Binan, and Santa Rosa), Metro Manila (Taguig, Pasig, Muntinlupa, Las Pinas, Paranaque, Makati, Pasay, Pateros, Mandaluyong, Manila, San Juan, Quezon City, and Marikina), and Rizal (Binangonan, Angono, Cainta, Taytay, Antipolo, Teresa, and San Mateo) within the next 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
